triage.summary: Lucía Martín requests that all future company payments go to a new bank account and asks Alex to confirm the records have been updated. She says the old account closes tomorrow, October 13.
triage.risk_reason: The email redirects payments to a new bank account and pressures Alex to act before the old account allegedly closes tomorrow. This could be a payment-diversion scam; verify the change through a previously trusted contact channel.
